skill1: Activates after landing 5 normal attack(s). Affects the target(s). ATK ▼ 7.95% for 5 sec. — enemy ATK debuff: the v1 boss deals no damage and enemy ATK is not an input to the damage formula, so the line has no consumer (it is NOT a Damage Taken ▲ debuff, which would benefit the team).

caveats: ⚑ Kit-silent triggers: both skill2 lines state a duration but carry NO activation clause. Modeled as `passive`, so each applies once at t=0 and lapses after its stated window (10 s / 5 s) instead of refreshing. Damage-inert for this kit either way, but the trigger identity is unverified.

⚑ teamHas.sameSquad FAILS CLOSED — if src/data/squads.ts carries no squad entry for ram, the 20.16 s burst-CDR never fires and her Burst I cadence stays at the flat 40 s cooldown. This is the ONE damage-relevant lever in the kit (faster Burst I → more full bursts), so the squad curation is load-bearing.

DEF ▲ 11.34% "of the skill user's DEF" has no caster-scaled DEF StatKey (no `casterDefPct` exists); authored as plain `defPct`, which is inert in v1 (self DEF does not affect own damage). Kept for kit completeness and as a future consumer hook; the caster-scaling is not represented.

Max HP ▲ 40.72% is offensively inert here — ram carries no `atkOfMaxHpPct`, and ally-granted Max HP never feeds a teammate's HP→ATK conversion. It does set the basis of the burst shield (10.08% of final Max HP); the sim models no HP pool, so the shield amount is recorded, not simulated.
"without restoring HP" — the Max HP grant emits NO recovery event. It is deliberately NOT paired with a `heal`, which would falsely fire teammates' `recovery` triggers (e.g. crown).

The burst shield targets ALL allies (self included) and fires their `shielded` triggers / satisfies `requiresShielded` gates — the only cross-unit damage channel in this kit. Do not skip it on isolation grounds.
override.note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⚑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number. ram (SR/Fire/Defender/Burst I) is a pure support/defensive kit — no damage effect of any kind. Modeled: (skill1) a full-burst-end self burst-CDR of 20.16 s gated on a same-squad ally; (skill2) a self Max HP ▲ 40.72% and a 2-lowest-HP-ally DEF ▲ 11.34%; (burst) an all-ally shield worth 10.08% of her final Max HP for 10 s. The burst-CDR is the only line that moves damage — it shortens her 40 s Burst I cooldown and therefore the team's full-burst cadence. Her skill1 target ATK ▼ is unmodeled (see `unmodeled`). No `noFb` is set (no damage riders exist to exempt) and `noRange` is engine-automatic.

audit.effectOrReason: Trigger would be hitCount{count:5} (SR hitsPerShot 1, so 5 rounds = 5 hits), but the effect it carries has no consumer — skipped with the whole block, recorded verbatim in unmodeled.skill1.

Enemy ATK debuff. v1 boss deals no damage and enemy ATK is not an input to the damage formula (only boss DEF is); resolveTargets({kind:'enemy'}) returns [] so a block would be a silent no-op. Distinct from damageTakenPct, which WOULD be modeled.

audit.kitLine: When Full Burst ends w/ same-squad ally
audit.effectOrReason: trigger {kind:'fullBurstEnd'} + block gate teamHas:{sameSquad:true}. "still on the battlefield" is scope-trivial (nobody dies at scope lock), so the gate is composition-only.
effect {kind:'burstCdr', seconds:20.16}, target self. `oncePerBattle` NOT set — the kit states no once-per-battle limit, so it recurs on every qualifying full-burst end (⚑).
target {kind:'self'}; no activation clause → trigger {kind:'passive'} (⚑ kit-silent).
buff stat 'targetMaxHpPct' value 40.72 durationSec 10 (self-cast, so it is her own Max HP). "without restoring HP" → no `heal` effect emitted.

audit.kitLine: Affects 2 ally unit(s) w/ lowest HP
audit.effectOrReason: target {kind:'alliesLowestHp', count:2}. No excludeSelf (the kit does not say "except self"). v1 has no HP pool, so the engine resolves this to the leftmost 2 allies as the documented stand-in.

audit.kitLine: DEF ▲ 11.34% of user's DEF for 5 sec
audit.effectOrReason: buff stat 'defPct' value 11.34 durationSec 5. Caster-scaling is NOT expressible (no casterDefPct StatKey); defPct is inert in v1. Kept per the "DEF/HP lines are not skippable" rule.
target {kind:'allies'} (no excludeSelf — "all allies" includes the caster).

audit.kitLine: Shield 10.08% of user's final Max HP
audit.effectOrReason: trigger {kind:'burstCast'} (the line sits in her OWN burst block) + effect {kind:'shield', maxHpPct:10.08, durationSec:10}. Fires teammates' `shielded` triggers and opens `requiresShielded` gates — the kit's only cross-unit channel.

flags.estimate: Gate active (assumed ram has a curated squad); burst-CDR 20.16 s recurring on EVERY qualifying full-burst end, not once per battle.
flags.reasoning: `sameSquad` fails closed by design — an owner with no entry in src/data/squads.ts never satisfies the gate, which would silently zero the only damage-relevant line in this kit (her 40 s Burst I cooldown would never be shortened). The kit text also states no once-per-battle limit, so recurring is the literal read, but that is the difference between ~1 extra Burst I cast and several over a 180 s fight.
flags.recipe: 1) Confirm src/data/squads.ts contains ram and note which co-units share her squad (the gate is composition-only at scope lock). 2) Record a fight with a same-squad ally present and count her Burst I casts / full-burst count vs a run without one; a recurring 20.16 s CDR on a 40 s cooldown should roughly halve her effective cycle after the first full burst. 3) Compare against the flat-40 s sim rotation log (ROT=1) — the full-burst COUNT is the discriminating observable.

flags.estimate: passive (applied once at battle start, lapsing after 10 s / 5 s respectively).
flags.reasoning: Neither ■ block carries an "Activates when …" clause, unlike both skill1 blocks in the same kit — so the prose gives no trigger at all, yet both lines state a finite duration. That combination is contradictory: a true permanent passive needs no duration, and a 10 s/5 s window implies an unstated refresh cadence (interval, on-hit, or an in-game HP-threshold condition the dump omits). Modeling it as `passive` + durationSec is the literal read and deliberately UNDER-credits rather than inventing an interval. Both lines are damage-inert for this kit (ram has no atkOfMaxHpPct and defPct is inert in v1), so the choice moves no damage today — it matters only if a future consumer reads her live Max HP (e.g. the burst shield basis) or DEF.
flags.recipe: Record a scope-lock fight with ram and watch her self buff-icon strip: if the Max HP icon re-arms on a fixed cadence, re-key to {kind:'interval', sec:N}; if it is present for the entire fight, drop durationSec; if it appears only after a triggering event (a hit count, a burst, an HP threshold), key it to that trigger. Same read for the 2-ally DEF grant on the ally icons.

flags.estimate: Datamined values used as given — SR, 6 rounds, ~1.0 s full charge, ~2.35 s reload.
flags.reasoning: ALWAYS-⚑ #1: rate_of_fire / reloadFrames are known-unreliable datamine fields, and the effective rate is quantized to 60 fps frame boundaries. Ram deals no kit damage, so the tuple only affects her own normal-attack output and burst-gauge generation — but her gauge contribution feeds the full-burst cadence her own burst-CDR is being judged on, so an error here confounds the flag above.
flags.recipe: Count shots and reloads off a focus recording of ram (ammo counter is the direct instrument for shots/sec, not full-burst counts, which are downstream of gauge); compare against the sim's shot log.

flags.estimate: Shield applies to all 5 allies at burst cast, duration 10 s, amount 10.08% of ram's final Max HP (including her own skill2 +40.72%, if that buff is live at cast time).
flags.reasoning: The shield's AMOUNT is kit-stated and needs no flag, but the SIM has no HP pool, so the amount is inert and the only live behaviour is the `shielded` event it emits. Whether that event fires for a teammate whose own gate is evaluated at cast time depends on ordering relative to the burst-cast frame, and whether ram's skill2 Max HP buff is active at cast (it is, under the `passive` model, only for the first 10 s of the fight) changes the recorded amount but nothing observable.
flags.recipe: Assert via the harness: run a comp containing a shield-gated consumer (a `requiresShielded` block or a `shielded` trigger) alongside ram and check the buffApply/damage events land in the window after her burstCast. No in-game measurement is needed for the event plumbing; the shield MAGNITUDE only becomes measurable if a future kit scales damage off shield value.
